name: Fishing
description: How fishing works: rods built from parts, the bite, the fight and the catch.

pages.title: Fishing
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- Rods are **built from parts**: a blank, a reel, line, a hook and a float, sinker or lure.
- Hold use to cast, **left-click** to strike a bite, then fight it with the **drag** and the reel.
- What bites depends on the water, the time and your bait.
- Fish have real **weights**.

A rod is a blank with parts fitted to it at a [#](2E5AAC)[Tackle Bench](entry://fishing/tackle_bench)[#](), or by right-clicking the rod with a part in your inventory. A rod holds fish up to a weight set by its weakest part.\
\
More than 180 fish bite across rivers, oceans, caves, lava and the void, from Create Galore Fishing, Hybrid Aquatic, Aquaculture, Alex's Caves and a few others.

pages.title: Fishing Journal
pages.text: Every player gets one on joining. Catch a fish to unlock its page: where it lives, when it bites, and your longest and heaviest so far.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Tip:** first fishing trip: a [](item://create_galore_fishing:bamboo_pole) (3 bamboo or sugar cane) needs no reel. Right-click it with a [](item://create_galore_fishing:string_line) and a [](item://create_galore_fishing:small_hook) in your inventory, add worms, and cast into any river. See [#](2E5AAC)[Food in Your First Days](entry://food/first_food)[#]().\
\
Aquaculture's own rods: [#](2E5AAC)[Aquaculture Fish and Old Rods](entry://fishing/aquaculture)[#]().
